items.body:
Sometime in 1986, perhaps in a Paris caf�, Dominique Cravic, a singer, guitarist, and musical archivist, met Robert Crumb, an underground cartoonist, banjo and mandolin player, and jug-band aficionado. Over a few glasses of marc, to continue to speculate, they conjured up the idea for Les Primitifs du futur.  Since then, they have recorded an impossible-to-categorize series of albums, with cover illustrations by Crumb, of which Les Crimes du Mussette is the fifth.
Weird and wonderful, it sounds like they rooted through an attic full of 78 RPM records, scribbled down some arrangements, and then played them on a collection of instruments they found in another attic, including accordion, sax, xylophone, clarinet, banjo, ukulele, theremin, Hawaiian guitar, bagpipe chanter (I�m guessing here), and musical saw.
Ne tirez pas sur le pianiste (excerpt)
The 27 short tracks are mostly voiced by Cravic, who talk-sings in the manner of an everyman Maurice Chevalier. He is often accompanied by the accordion, a customary instrument in the bal-musette style that remains a strong element of the eclectic range of styles they have managed to synthesize. They also include ragtime, jug, French chanson, and, to my ears, skiffle,  just to get the list started.
Ukulele Lady (excerpt)
The liner notes point out that �Les Crimes du Musette is also a gold mine for scholars, a veritable treasure trove.� Exploring the treasures is beyond my scope here, as each tune has a long history. A highlight for me is the humorous �Ukulele Lady� from 1925, which first delighted me on Arlo Guthrie�s 1971 album
Hobo�s Lullaby
. The song has also been covered by Bing Crosby, Peter Sellers, and Bette Midler.
N'oublie pas Gr�co (excerpt)
A more serious item is �N�oublie pas Gr�co� (Don�t Forget Gr�co�)  is a tribute to the legendary chanteuse and heroine of the French Resistance, Juliette Gr�co, who died in 2020. You will also hear old chestnuts like �Fum�e aux yeux� (�Smoke Gets in Your Eyes�),  �Boude pas� (�Take Five�), and �Prive d�amour� (�As Time Goes By�).
This record is a curiosity, but it is performed by serious musicians with total commitment. In this, I was reminded of the similarly indefinable Dan Hicks & the Hot Licks. Long-forgotten music and abandoned styles are given new animation with obvious enthusiasm and care. Speaking about himself and his collaborators, many of whom are in their seventies, Dominique Cravic says, �The young have fire, but we have light.� In its own little corner,
Les Crimes du Musette
shines bright.

items._genre: musette / French chanson / jug band / ragtime / eclectic folk
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑由Dominique Cravic领衔的Les Primitifs du futur乐队与漫画家Robert Crumb合作录制，是其第五张作品。乐评指出，乐队从大量老式78转唱片中汲取灵感，使用包括手风琴、萨克斯、木琴、单簧管、班卓琴、尤克里里、特雷门琴、夏威夷吉他、风笛及音乐锯在内的多种乐器，营造出难以归类的杂糅风格。27首短曲大多由Cravic以近似法国香颂的口吻演唱，融合了bal-musette、拉格泰姆、 jug band、法国香颂及skiffle等多种元素。其中收录了向2020年去世的法国抵抗运动传奇歌手Juliette Gréco致敬的《N'oublie pas Gréco》，以及《Ukulele Lady》等老歌的重新演绎。乐评强调，尽管作品充满古怪气质，但演奏者皆为严肃音乐人，对被遗忘的音乐风格进行了充满热情的重新激活。

items._cn_summary: 这张作品是作曲家大卫·祖宾斯基为普瑞姆四重奏创作的《Two Views of a Prayer》，属于该组合"Unlocking Your Inner Composer"系列合作项目之一。作品于2025年11月在费城免费图书馆首演，邀请了人声艺术家乌苏拉·拉克、打击乐手蒂肖恩·索雷以及小提琴家卡洛斯·圣地亚哥共同参与编创与演奏。整首作品时长不到四分钟，在粗粝声响与抒情段落之间反复游走，展现出室内乐编制下的多重质感与张力。普瑞姆四重奏以跨越流派边界的演奏风格著称，此次合作延续了他们将人声、打击乐与弦乐融为一体的实验路径，是了解这一组合当代创作理念的一个切入点。

items.body:
A debut, digital-only EP from a Danish trio, led by one of the Nordic folk scene�s outstanding and experienced vocalists, Mia Guldhammer. Five tracks, with the musicians bringing their own perspectives to mostly traditional music. There�s a lovely ancient, creaky mood throughout.
The opener, �Svennedal,� with its rough, cantering rhythm, offers a perfect shop window for Guldhammer�s impressive, persuasive voice, while jaw harp and bagpipes bring an insistent propulsion to �Nordg�rd,� the only original here, by band member Morten Musicus.
Cimbalom adds a delicate backdrop to the traditional �Agnete Of Bjergmanden,� with Guldhammer�s soft jaw harp offering extra textures to the other instruments, as it brings a springy opening to the final cut, �Orms�,� mingling with flute and strings to create something quite thrilling and off kilter on this instrumental.
Five tracks, and an introduction to a band that already seems very mature and accomplished. A strong beginning � what will GuldGanger do with an entire album?
items.label: Go' Danish Folk Music
items._cn_summary: 这是一张来自丹麦三人组合的处女作数字EP，核心人物是北欧民谣领域经验丰富的主唱Mia Guldhammer。五首曲目大多取材于传统音乐，但乐手们在演绎中融入了各自的视角与理解。开场曲以粗犷的奔跑节奏展现了主唱极具说服力的声线；唯一的原创曲目由乐队成员Morten Musicus创作，加入了口簧与风笛带来强劲推进感。传统曲目中融入洋琴作为细腻底色，口簧在不同曲目中提供额外的音色层次；终曲作为纯器乐曲，融合长笛与弦乐，产生奇特而令人兴奋的失衡感。整体氛围古老而略带吱嘎声，显示出乐队超越新人阶段的成熟度。数字发行方式与传统北欧根源音乐的碰撞是这张EP值得关注的特质。

items.body: Editor's note: When this set of recordings came to me, I was at a loss as to how to share it. It's not music, in any traditional sense (although there is some freestyle rapping), and a 'review' of such an artifact of reality seems superfluous to the content. Instead, I asked sound recordist Ian Brennan if I could simply use his own brief commentary and the recordings he made on the street in Chicago. Twenty-five people afflicted by gun violence participated, many from the very block we�d setup on. Many neighbors were pulled-in spontaneously. Almost every one in the community had been impacted by violence somehow� both on the receiving and the inflicting end, and many both. One woman had just come from a memorial service, another was on her way. That�s how far-reaching the violence. Almost no one went untouched. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors By chance, we convened on the day that Trump ordered the deployment of the National Guard to the city. The recording took place on the front porch of the leader's ninety-four-year-old grandmother's house�right in the heart of the ��hood,� beneath the Midway Airport�s landing path. A pair of stray pitfalls stalked the block. But the grandmother warned not of gunshots, but the mosquitoes in her yard. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors We were in a section of town that one man defined as �the forgotten parts.� Just a short jaunt from the designer clothes shops and posh hotels of the city�s Magnificent Mile, the Southside spawned such legendary Blues artists as Muddy Waters, Willie Dixon, and Howlin� Wolf. Jazz musicians like Lionel Hampton and even Benny Goodman, hailed from nearby. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors The participants ranged in age from seventeen to sixty-seven, but the pattern held true. The person who�d asserted �you�ll really want to hear my story,� was the least compelling. The reluctant, the most moving. One elder�s tough facade broke down as she shared how she�d lost both her sons. She tearfully apologized, �I�m sorry. I�m sorry. I�m sorry.� But she had nothing to be sorry for. Society is the one that owes the apology� for the staggering statistical inequities of which no reasonable defense can be made. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors Editor's note: The full set of recordings are available on Bandcamp. Any profits from this project will be donated to Cure Violence Global , who states that their mission is "advancing an evidence-based health approach to end violence globally." When I asked him about the background sounds, producer Ian Brennan added, "No music is added. It�s all sounds from the source environment. I also ran loops/drones on a different track in the background as they spoke, and when they ended up being incidentally/somewhat magically/eerily synchronous, that is what was used for a few pieces with 'accompaniment' like some of the rap freestyles."
items._genre: field recording / spoken word / documentary / free rap
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑并非传统意义上的音乐作品，而是声音记录者伊恩·布伦南在芝加哥南区街头录制的枪支暴力幸存者口述集。二十五位参与者年龄跨度从十七岁到六十七岁，背景各异，包括刚参加完追悼会的女性、失去两个儿子后哽咽道歉的老人等。录音地点位于一位九十四岁祖母家的前廊，背景中混入机场降落声、街区的野狗等环境噪音，没有任何后期添加的音乐。一位参与者有即兴说唱，其余均为口述。专辑的特别之处在于它作为社会现实的声学文献而非艺术创作呈现，制作者明确放弃了传统评论框架，直接使用录音者自述。收益将捐给致力于以公共卫生方式终结暴力的组织。整体形式介于田野录音、社会声音艺术与音乐评论的边界地带。

items._cn_summary: Ondanaconda是一支来自日内瓦的四重奏团体，成员构成横跨古典与电子领域，包括单簧管演奏家、人声歌手、多乐器演奏家以及电子音乐作曲者。专辑以同名为名，强调回归基础、去除冗余的创作理念。据乐评描述，这支组合与日内瓦实验音乐圈联系紧密，成员各自的音乐背景覆盖广泛，几乎涉及所有可想象的音乐类型，在日内瓦实验场景的各个角落都有人脉与交集。专辑呈现的是一种跨领域的协作，将古典乐器的传统演奏与现代电子作曲手法并置，让单簧管、人声与电子设备在同一个框架内对话。虽然原文为节选且篇幅较短，无法对具体曲目或录音细节做更多分析，但从乐评的整体描述来看，这张作品更倾向于当代即兴与跨界融合的实验美学，适合对欧洲地下实验场景有兴趣的听众进一步探索。

items.body: Tyondai Braxton Splayed Werks The American composer (and former member of Battles) mutates familiar sounds into unrecognisable new forms Splayed Werks by Tyondai Braxton Despite the availability of affordable recording technologies, whole careers, movements, and scenes still live and die scarcely documented. Some of it is by choice – music whose authors want it defined by ephemerality and elusiveness. But in most cases, the reasons are practical, ranging from a chronic lack of time in a hyperactive world to stubborn perfectionism. Conscious of this, US composer Tyondai Braxton posits that the artist's essential task is to document one's creative practice and preserve it as a testament of lived experience. For him, the act of capturing ideas as they arise becomes one of the most... The post Tyondai Braxton – Splayed Werks appeared first on The Quietus.
items._cn_summary: Tyondai Braxton（前 Battles 成员）的专辑《Splayed Werks》强调将熟悉的声音素材变异为无法辨认的新形态。文章开篇讨论了当代音乐场景中大量创作缺乏记录的现状，认为艺术家有责任记录并保存创作实践，将其作为生活经验的见证。Braxton 将捕捉稍纵即逝的创作念头视为核心任务，专辑本身即是对这一理念的实践。文中提到他通过录音技术将原始素材进行变异处理，使原本可辨识的声响转化为全新的抽象形态，这在主题上与当代作曲和电子实验领域对声音物质性的探索相契合。整体来看，这张专辑聚焦于声音变形与素材解构的创作过程，呈现出强烈的实验性和观念艺术色彩，但现有评论文本过短，无法对其具体音乐手法和最终成果作更深入判断。

items.excerpt: Lee “Scratch” Perry recorded his vocal for “Angels” at Black Ark Studio in Switzerland over a decade before the song reached its final form, laying it over a rough beat with the words: “When I recorded the vocals, I only listened to the heartbeat.” Born Rainford Hugh Perry in Jamaica, Perry spent the 1960s and 70s building the foundations of dub from his Black Ark Studio in Kingston, producing Bob Marley and the Wailers, Junior Murvin and the Congos before rel
items.body: Lee “Scratch” Perry recorded his vocal for “Angels” at Black Ark Studio in Switzerland over a decade before the song reached its final form, laying it over a rough beat with the words: “When I recorded the vocals, I only listened to the heartbeat.” Born Rainford Hugh Perry in Jamaica, Perry spent the 1960s and 70s building the foundations of dub from his Black Ark Studio in Kingston, producing Bob Marley and the Wailers, Junior Murvin and the Congos before relocating first to London and then to Switzerland. Steve Marshall, the English producer who returned to the unfinished rhythm years later, added new drums, electric guitar, piano and synth, steering the track toward Lovers Rock. Geo Baddoo, the Somerset-raised, London-based soul and R&B artist, joined the project after that, writing a gentle, contemplative lyric that pushed “Angels” further into Lovers Rock territory. Baddoo built her opening lines around a refrain Perry had left in the vocal, drawn from Psalm 87:7: “singers and players of the instruments.” Dennis Bovell, the Barbados-born producer credited with shaping UK Lovers Rock in the 1970s, handled the single’s dub mix. “Angels” leads Scratch Is Alive, due on State of Emergency on 13 November and timed to mark what would have been Perry’s 90th birthday in 2026. It’s the fifth album Perry and Marshall have made together, following the Grammy-nominated The End Of An American Dream and Revelation, and it gathers unreleased vocal and dub recordings made in Switzerland and London. Stream “Angels” HERE The post Daily Discovery: Lee “Scratch” Perry x Geo Baddoo – Angels appeared first on Rhythm Passport.
items._cn_summary: 这张作品收录了Lee "Scratch" Perry多年前在瑞士Black Ark Studio录制的人声素材，由英国制作人Steve Marshall在此基础上重新编配，添加鼓组、电吉他、钢琴与合成器，将原本粗粝的节奏引向Lovers Rock方向。伦敦灵魂乐与R&B歌手Geo Baddoo随后加入，围绕Perry原声遗留的圣经诗篇片段撰写歌词，进一步强化Lovers Rock的柔情质感。牙买加裔英国制作人Dennis Bovell负责dub混音处理，为作品保留了dub传统的空间感与回响层次。这张专辑是Perry与Marshall合作的第五张作品，汇集了瑞士与伦敦两地未发行的人声与dub录音，以纪念Perry即将到来的90岁生日。整体制作思路是对历史素材的再发掘与跨年代重塑，而非全新实验创作。

items.body: Review by Abrasmatheus — This was my first time listening to No Earthly Connection, and I came to it with high expectations. I have always been a big fan of Yes, so I already knew how impressive Rick Wakeman could be with keyboards. Even so, this album was a very pleasant surprise.From the beginning, I was impressed by the beautiful melodies and the strongly progressive character of the music. I would describe it mainly as Symphonic Prog, Progressive Rock and, of course, with strong Classical influences. The arrangements are complex, grandiose, melodic and atmospheric, but the music never loses its emotional side.Rick Wakeman is obviously the great highlight here. This album is a wonderful showcase of his talent with keyboards and synthesizers. Many of the things I love about his playing in Yes are present here as well, but in a more personal setting where he can really show what he is capable of. His synthesizers give the album an enormous sense of grandeur.I also really enjoyed the way the album works as a complete experience. I always appreciate progressive rock albums that encourage you to sit down and listen to the whole record instead of simply picking individual songs. No Earthly Connection works particularly well in this format.The concept is another aspect that made the album special to me. The first five sections form Music Reincarnate: The Warning, The Maker, The Spaceman, The Realisation and The Reaper. The concept deals with the idea of a "musical soul" accompanying a human being through life and continuing through reincarnation after death. Wakeman presented it as a possibility rather than as an absolute explanation, exploring ideas about life, death, evolution and things that are difficult to explain. I found this particularly fascinating because of the spiritual dimension of the album. The recurring idea of the music of the soul, together with references to reincarnation and the journey of the soul, gives the music an additional meaning for me. The atmosphere is cosmic, epic, dramatic and almost cinematic, but also very beautiful and emotional.My favorite part is The Warning, especially its final section. There is a vocal passage that reminds me a lot of Jon Anderson, and when it becomes more dramatic, I absolutely love it. It is one of those moments that immediately caught my attention.The Maker has an incredible Rick Wakeman synthesizer passage that sounds unmistakably like him. It gives the album an enormous sense of grandeur and is one of the moments that most reminded me why I enjoy his work with Yes.I also really like The Spaceman, especially because of its beautiful melody and the way it continues the idea of the musical soul. The Realisation is another favorite. I love its melody and lyrics, and I found it particularly interesting how the album continues returning to the idea of the soul and its journey.The Reaper is also excellent. It has another wonderful melody and recalls ideas from earlier parts of the album, which gave me the impression of a return or continuation of the soul. This is my own interpretation, but I really enjoyed experiencing the album this way. The instrumental ending is also fantastic and reminded me of some moments from Yes.Finally, The Prisoner has a more dramatic character and fits very well into the overall atmosphere. The final piece, The Lost Cycle, also helps give the album a sense of completion, extending its ideas into questions about evolution and possible advanced civilizations beyond Earth. (Wikipedia)Honestly, I did not find any uninteresting moments here. For me, the album is beautiful from beginning to end.The vocals are also extremely important. They contribute greatly to the atmosphere and emotional impact of the album. Without them, I don't think No Earthly Connection would have the same character.The production is very good as well. Wakeman produced the album and played an impressive variety of keyboard instruments, including Moog synthesizers, Mellotron, Hammond C3 organ, pipe organ, grand piano, electric piano, clavinet and harpsichord. The instrumentation is very rich, but the keyboards and synthesizers remain the main identity of the record. (rwcc.com)At several points, the album reminds me of Yes, particularly because of Wakeman's keyboard style and the use of synthesizers. I can also hear similarities with other progressive rock bands from the 1970s.I wouldn't say that the album is radically original compared with everything else being produced in progressive rock at the time. I don't hear something that completely separates it from the progressive rock of its era. However, this does not take anything away from its beauty or magnitude.For me, the three greatest strengths are the vocals, the synthesizers and the melodies.I honestly cannot point to any significant weaknesses. The album works very well as a complete experience.Since this is the first Rick Wakeman solo album I have listened to, I cannot yet compare it with the rest of his solo discography. But this album certainly made me interested in exploring more of his solo work.I will definitely listen to No Earthly Connection many more times. It is an album that I enjoyed not only for its progressive rock qualities, but also because its ideas about the soul, reincarnation and existence gave the music a deeper personal meaning for me.Rating: 4/5No Earthly Connection is an album of beautiful melodies, impressive synthesizers, powerful vocals and grand progressive arrangements. Above all, for me, it is an album of music that feeds the soul.
items._genre: symphonic prog / progressive rock / classical rock
items._cn_summary: Rick Wakeman的独奏作品，以键盘和合成器为核心，呈现古典与前卫摇滚的融合。专辑以"音乐灵魂"的概念贯穿五大部分，探讨生命、死亡与轮回的主题，音乐氛围宏大且具有电影感。编曲复杂而旋律性强，合成器音色赋予作品史诗般的规模感。The Warning的人声段落带有Jon Anderson的影子，The Maker中的合成器段落极具个人特色。作为Yes成员的个人表达空间，这张专辑延续了他在乐队中的技术路线，但更注重整体概念和情感叙事。评论中提到的宇宙感、戏剧性和情感深度，反映了七十年代交响前卫摇滚的典型美学特征。

items.body: The Prom on August 23, which was presented by the BBC Symphony Orchestra, conducted by Alain Altinoglu, concluded with a performance of Amérique by Edgard Varèses, having begun with Stravinsky’s Symphonies of Wind Instruments in its 1947 version, The Dvorak ‘Cello Concerto, with Gautier Capuçon soloist, and Debussy’s Prelude to the Afternoon of a Faun. The title of the piece had dual meanings, just as Varèses’s intentions were multiple. The work was on one hand a sort of portrait of the active and bustling New York City, but it also had the intention of opening new, as it were, vistas of sound available for composition. The title implied both the new world as it existed, but also the possibility of exploration. So the music is full of energy and activity and the depiction of day to day noise in a specific way that was new in music. Although it has a momentary quite beginning (possibly referring to the beginning of The Afternoon of the Faun and offering a tribute to Debussy), Amérique’s energy and intensity is incessant and ever increasing. That intensity and energy was completely realized by this performance. The Prom on August 22 was presented by the Chineke! Orchestra, conducted by Jonathon Heyward and featured the soprano Angel Blue. It opened with a reconstruction of a work by the African American, British educated, at the Royal Academy of Music, composer, Edmund Thornton Jenkins. The work, which was conceived when he was a student in London, called Ballet, was reconstructed from existing parts and a piano reduction, by his great-newphew, Tuffus Zimbabwe. It was the first performance of any of Jenkins’s music on the Proms. The central work on the program was Samuel Barber’s Knoxville Summer of 1915, which featured Blue. The piece sets a text by James Agee and can be justifiably described as nostalgic. It is also arguably Barber’s best piece. The text is written in the first person, but Blue gave it a quality somewhat akin to what happens in Thorton Wilder plays, especially Our Town, where a character addresses the audience directly. She gave it an especially directly personal and expressive quality that was very moving and unforgettable. She followed the Barber with some songs from what is probably described these days as the American Song Book. Her performances of those pieces, including My Funny Valentine (Richard Rogers and Lorenz Hart), Our Love Is Here to Stay (Goerge and Ira Gershwin), That Old Black Magic (Harold Arlen and Johnny Mercer), and Puttin’ On the Ritz (Irving Berlin), was mostly masterful and compelling. For this listener the performance of My Funny Valentine compared favorably to Ella Fitzgerald’s recording. The order of the songs was not the same as what was listed in the program, and one of the songs listed was not performed. The concert concluded with a very lovely and lovely-sounding performance of the Dvorak Eighth Symphony. As is the current practice, the Prom on August 29, presented by the Oslo Philharmonic, conducted by Mirga Gražinytė-Tyla, was advertised as containing music by Stravinsky and Prokofiev without mentioning that it would be opened by the first Proms performance of Symphonic Poem no. 1, ‘Forest Morning’ by Øyvind Torvund. The work was as evocative as one might expect a piece with that title to be. It seemed to have at the beginning, random, or at least random seeming, recordings of birds, but those sound morphed into similar figures that were clearly played by instruments in the orchestra, so that after a while it wasn’t completely clear that there ever had been recordings of actual birds. The program quoted Torvund in saying “…I also like to think about all the smaller, perhaps psychedelic sounds in nature, those that are found naturally and can remind you of electronic sounds. The mirroring of sounds is one of the things that fascinates me the most.” So who knows? In any case, the shape and progress of the piece was compelling and impressive and very enjoyable. The Stravinsky work was the Violin Concerto, which was performed with the soloist Patricia Kopatchinskyaja. As her encore, regretting the absence of cadenzas and chances for soloistic displays in the piece, she played a very technically complicated and showy “candenza” which she had written based on material in the concerto. The concert concluded with a rousing performance of music from Romeo and Juliet by Prokofiev. As an encore at the end of the concert, the orchestra played another piece by Torvund, apparently orchestrated in the five previous days, entitled Starry Night. This one clearly made use of recorded sounds and was highly effective and also very enjoyable. The post BBC Proms Varese Barber Torvund Jenkins et al appeared first on Sequenza21.

items.body: Musicians from Berlin, Pietrasanta and Ibagué make up Hellkern Warriors, and the gothic rock project’s fourth single, “Rain, Steam & Speed”, is out now as a self-released digital track on Bandcamp and the streaming platforms. The song runs 4:16 and came out on 18 April 2026. Hellkern Warriors mix analog synths, guitar, bass and drums with a cinematic production, and the lyrics deal with futurism, inner conflict and decay. Rain, Steam & Speed by Hellkern Warriors The band describes the track as “an urban nightscape of rain, neon lights, and unstoppable speed”. An official video accompanies the single, and the song currently tops the public vote in the Alternative category of the HOFA Song Contest 2026. Singer Tom Radar wrote to Side-Line that the new release “continues the sonic vision of our previous singles Petrol & Water and Helkern Warriors”. All three, plus “Endless Road”, are single tracks; the band has not released an EP or album so far. About Hellkern Warriors Hellkern Warriors formed in early 2025 as a four-piece spread across three countries. Drummer and producer Mauricio Castro (Ibagué, Colombia) initiated the project together with Alessandro Vezzoni (Pietrasanta, Italy), who plays synths under the names Kabal Apokalypse and Dylan Phoenix and runs Funeral Records Autoproduction; his earlier projects include Erotic Funeral, the EBM act Toxic Industry and the gothic rock project Binario 0. Tom Radar, singer and guitarist of the Berlin darkwave band Radarfield, took over lyrics, vocals and guitar after presenting the first demos in June 2025, and Colombian guitarist and bassist Fabian Parra, of Ghoulish Pain and Lemarchand, plays bass. Castro, who also drums in Impromtus ad Mortem and Lemarchand, mixes and produces the recordings at his own Artgot Studios. The band name refers to the Helkern computer worm. The debut single, spelled “Helkern Warriors” after the worm, appeared on 12 September 2025, followed by “Petrol & Water” on 1 November 2025 and “Endless Road” on 28 December 2025, both with official videos, and the band also appears on the compilation “Pulse In The Void – Vol.1”. “Rain, Steam & Speed”, out since 18 April 2026, is the fourth single, and the group collects the series under the working title “The Pulse of the Void”.

items.body: Thirteen new extended versions, cut from the original tapes, make up the next Telex release. “MAXI” arrives on Mute on 4 December 2026 as a double album on transparent red and blue vinyl and as a CD, with a digital release to follow in 2027. The launch track is a maxi version of “Moskow Diskow”, the 1979 single from the Belgian synthpop trio’s debut album, now out as official audio on Mute’s YouTube channel. The album is available to pre-order. Telex were Marc Moulin (1942-2008), Dan Lacksman and Michel Moers, and the two surviving members went back to the original tapes to build the Maxi versions, which come with new mixes and new mastering. The album collects “Moskow Diskow”, “Soul Waves”, “L’Amour Toujours”, “Rock Around The Clock”, “Temporary Chicken”, “Dance To The Music”, “Eurovision”, “En Route Vers De Nouvelles Aventures”, “Rendez-Vous Dans L’Espace”, “Peanuts”, “Twist À Saint-Tropez”, “Spike Jones” and “We Are All Getting Old”, each carrying the “(Maxi)” suffix. The tracklist spells the opener “Moskow Diskow”, as on the original single, while the audio upload titles it “Moscow Diskow”. Telex revisit ‘Euro-vision’ and ‘Rock Around The Clock’ Two of the extended tracks come with a television history. “Euro-vision” was Belgium’s entry at the Eurovision Song Contest in 1980, where it finished 17th of 19 with 14 points. Moers described the entry as “very Situationist International, the worm in the apple.” The band set out to finish either first or last, and did neither. Their cover of Bill Haley’s “Rock Around The Clock”, slowed down and sung through a vocoder, brought the trio an invitation to perform on Top of the Pops in 1979; Mute calls it “a ticking, vocoderised, supremely deadpan robot parody of the original”. The later material on “MAXI” includes the cut-up “rap” of “Peanuts”, from 1988’s “Looney Tunes”, and “Rendez-Vous Dans L’Espace”. About Telex Telex formed in Brussels in 1978, when Marc Moulin, Dan Lacksman and Michel Moers set out to make electronic pop without guitars. Their first single was a cover of Les Chats Sauvages’ “Twist à Saint-Tropez”, and the debut album “Looking for Saint-Tropez” (1979) carried “Moskow Diskow” and “Rock Around The Clock”. “Neurovision” followed in 1980, the year of the Eurovision entry, and “Sex” in 1981, with lyrics co-written with Sparks. “Wonderful World” appeared in 1984 and “Looney Tunes” in 1988, after which the trio remixed its catalogue as “Les Rythmes Automatiques” in 1989 and then went quiet as a recording unit. The sixth and last studio album, “How Do You Dance?”, came out in 2006. Moulin died on 26 September 2008, and Telex announced their retirement that year. The partnership with Mute began in 2021 with “This Is Telex”, a 14-track compilation released on 30 April 2021 with the tracks newly mixed and remastered by Lacksman and Moers. It added two previously unreleased covers, “Dear Prudence” by The Beatles and “The Beat Goes On” by Sonny & Cher, both found while the compilation was being assembled. Mute then reissued the six studio albums, remastered from the original tapes, as a limited vinyl and CD “Telex” box set, announced in October 2022 with the teaser “EP1” and released on 14 April 2023. Three days later Lacksman and Moers sat down with Mute founder Daniel Miller for a public talk in Brussels (A night with Telex and Mute Records founder Daniel Miller in Brussels). Moers went on to release his second solo album, “As Is”, in 2024, led by the single “Microwaves” with Claudia Brücken of Propaganda. “MAXI” is the first Telex release of newly made versions since that box set, and the third stage of the Mute campaign after the compilation and the reissues.
items._cn_summary: 比利时三人组Telex即将发行13首扩展版作品合集，由幸存的两位成员从原始磁带重新混音并完成新的母带处理。专辑收录了从1979年首张专辑到1988年《Looney Tunes》中的代表曲目，包括比利时1980年欧洲电视歌唱大赛参赛曲以及在英国BBC节目表演过的《Rock Around The Clock》慢速声码器翻唱版本。两位成员将原曲拆解、重组为更长的混音版本，强调电子合成器与人声处理器的结合，并在1988年的《Peanuts》中运用了拼贴式的说唱段落。该合集以透明红蓝双色彩胶唱片与CD形式发行，延续了Mute厂牌一贯的电气流行路线。

items.body: Everything on the record was played, produced and recorded in one house. Fear Maintenance, the solo project of Burlington, Ontario musician Colin Adams, released a cover of Joy Division‘s “Shadowplay” with a video posted to the project’s own YouTube channel on 13 August 2026. The track is also on Spotify and other streaming services. Adams built the project around other people’s songs. He describes the aim as to “simultaneously pay homage to and reimagine some of the darker songs from the post-punk bands of the late 1970s and 1980s, which inspired him to become a musician […]” How Fear Maintenance rework ‘Shadowplay’ The version keeps the song’s structure and moves the weight onto the guitars. Where Martin Hannett’s 1979 production left space around the parts, Adams fills it with distortion and a thicker low end, pushing the arrangement toward Ministry-style industrial metal. He plays every part himself. “Shadowplay” first appeared on “Unknown Pleasures”, the Joy Division debut album released by Factory Records in June 1979. The song has been covered repeatedly since, most visibly by The Killers, whose version was recorded for the soundtrack to Anton Corbijn’s Ian Curtis film “Control” and released as a download single on 9 October 2007. About Fear Maintenance Fear Maintenance is the solo project of Colin Adams, a musician based in Burlington, Ontario, Canada. Adams plays, produces and records the material alone in his home studio there. The project revisits post-punk songs from the late 1970s and 1980s, taking the records that led Adams to pick up an instrument and putting them through heavier arrangements. No original material has been released under the name. “Shadowplay” is the current single, released with a video on 13 August 2026 and distributed to streaming platforms through LANDR. Fear Maintenance has no Bandcamp page and no Discogs entry, and no label is involved. The project’s material is published through its YouTube channel and on streaming services, and no album or EP has been announced. The Joy Division catalogue keeps drawing this kind of attention. Side-Line marked the anniversary of “Closer” in July 2026, forty-six years after the band’s second and final album appeared.
items._cn_summary: Fear Maintenance 是加拿大安大略省伯灵顿音乐人 Colin Adams 的个人计划，专长于重新演绎1970年代末至1980年代后朋克乐队的暗色调作品。此番翻唱 Joy Division 名作《Shadowplay》，保留原作歌曲骨架，将重心转移至吉他层面，以失真音效与更厚的低频填充 Martin Hannett 原版中留白的空间，编曲方向推向 Ministry 式工业金属。所有乐器均由 Adams 一人独立在家中工作室完成演奏、制作与录制。该计划尚未发行原创作品，也无厂牌介入，素材仅通过 YouTube 频道与流媒体平台发布。

items.excerpt: Texas electro-industrial veterans Mentallo & The Fixer are returning to one of the defining records in their catalog with a newly remastered edition of Where Angels Fear To Tread, due digitally October 16 through Re:Mission Entertainment, followed by its first-ever vinyl pressing on November 20. items.body: Texas electro-industrial veterans Mentallo & The Fixer are returning to one of the defining records in their catalog with a newly remastered edition of Where Angels Fear To Tread, due digitally October 16 through Re:Mission Entertainment, followed by its first-ever vinyl pressing on November 20. Originally released by Zoth Ommog in Europe in 1994 and licensed by Metropolis Records for North America the following year, Where Angels Fear To Tread was the third full-length from brothers Gary and Dwayne Dassing, following No Rest For The Wicked and Revelations 23. Its 13-track original sequence includes enduring club staples Decomposed, Sacrilege, and Atom Smasher, songs that helped cement the duo’s place in the harsher, more rhythmically adventurous wing of 1990s electro-industrial music. Alfa Matrix later revisited the album as part of its 2014 Zothera CD box set, though that edition featured new artwork. For the 2026 edition, Jeff Mortimer at JM Mastering has prepared a fresh remaster for vinyl and digital, while Nathan Winter of Industriarts restored the original artwork. The physical edition expands the album to 15 tracks with two remixes and arrives as a 2LP gatefold pressed on yellow and red inverted splatter vinyl, limited to 250 copies worldwide. The gatefold also includes complete lyrics and new commentary from Gary Dassing on the making of the record. The album came together through a home-recording process that now feels almost archaeological in its limitations, with the brothers working from cassette masters while sequencing their synthesizers by computer and stretching a modest setup as far as it could go. “All master recordings at this time were recorded straight to cassette, believe it or not,” says Gary Dassing. “No multi track recording was involved. All vocals were recorded live as the computer sequencer would run the synthesizers. Crazy to think about it, the art of home recording and how far technology has come. ‘Look ma, no equipment necessary! Just some software and a laptop!’ Dwayne and I were sort of flying blind at the time. Everything was a learning experience, and a costly one. New tech in those years was extremely expensive, so you had to be dedicated. Hell, I remember when Dwayne and I lived off bean and cheese tacos just to get that next piece of gear. We were addicted.” The digital edition goes deeper into the archive with seven remixes and 20 tracks in total. It is available to pre-order now through Bandcamp ahead of its October 16 release across streaming platforms, while the vinyl edition is expected to ship November 20. The reissue continues Re Entertainment’s ongoing work with the Mentallo & The Fixer catalogue, following remastered editions of No Rest For The Wicked, Vengeance Is Mine, and Love Is the Law, alongside renewed attention to related projects Reign of Roses and Kitty Kosmonaut. You can order the vinyl version of Where Angels Fear To Tread here. items.body: Review by alainPP — While the 2022 *A Voyage / A Destination* featured numerous guests?such as Eric Gillette, Lars Fredrik Fr�islie, and Mariana Semkina?the 2024 *A Voyage / A Destination Part 2* featured only Dennis Atlas as a guest on synths.Whereas the 2022 release offered conventional, classic prog rock?a safe, progressive art-rock sound?the 2024 album changed course, delivering a distinctive, vibrant post-rock sound.It is an accessible album with seamlessly flowing tracks that blend rock and classical instrumentation, evoking the gently melancholic atmospheres favored by Explosions in the Sky and Sigur R�s, and building through long, dreamlike crescendos that invite meditation?or contemplation; take your pick.At times, the album even ventures into the pastoral territory of Big Big Train, demonstrating the remarkable musical breadth of these accomplished musicians.
items._cn_summary: 这是VERSA乐队2024年发行的第二部分作品，相比2022年首作依赖多位客座乐手的方式，本作仅邀请Dennis Atlas参与合成器演奏，呈现出更为统一的后摇气质。乐评指出专辑整体走向从前作的传统前卫摇滚转向更具辨识度的后摇风格，曲目之间衔接流畅，将摇滚乐器与古典乐器自然编织在一起。文本中将其氛围与Explosions in the Sky和Sigur Rós的轻柔忧郁气质相比较，乐曲通过绵长的梦境式渐层推进来营造沉思感。偶尔流露的田园化段落让人联想到Big Big Train，展示了乐手在多种风格之间的驾驭能力。

items.body: HANDS will return to Berlin’s Urban Spree on Saturday, 2 January 2027 for another New Year edition of HANDS Label Night, bringing together six live projects and two DJ sets for an evening moving through rhythm’n’noise, industrial techno and the harder edges of electronic music. The live line-up features SONAR, NULLVEKTOR, GREYHOUND, ICD-10, ESPECTRA NEGRA and MARIE, while HANDS founder Udo Wiessmann and HELLS will take care of the DJ sets. The night begins at 19:00, with doors also opening at 19:00. It is a particularly representative cross-section of the label’s history and current direction. SONAR, the Belgian project of Dirk Ivens and Eric Van Wonterghem, remain one of the defining names associated with rhythm’n’noise; their most recent HANDS album, “Future Cries”, arrived in 2023 after a nine-year album break. NULLVEKTOR, Stefan Böhm’s long-running project, connects industrial techno with rhythm’n’noise and has been part of the HANDS orbit since the early 2000s. GREYHOUND return with their uncompromising rhythmic approach, while ICD-10 arrive after releasing “Quantum Disruption” in May 2026, an album built around industrial-techno propulsion, seismic low-end pressure and tightly controlled rhythmic structures; it also includes a collaboration with GREYHOUND on “Merging Power”. ESPECTRA NEGRA, the project of Verónica Mota, brings the darker and more abrasive end of industrial techno to the bill, while MARIE completes the six-act live programme. The event also continues what has become a recurring Urban Spree tradition. HANDS staged its previous New Year Label Night there on 3 January 2026, following other Berlin editions at the same venue. The Dortmund-based label itself was founded by Udo Wiessmann in 1990 and became closely associated with the development of rhythm’n’noise while maintaining a catalogue extending into industrial techno, IDM, breakcore, ambient, electronica and sound art. HANDS Label Night Berlin – Saturday, 2 January 2027, Urban Spree Live: SONAR NULLVEKTOR GREYHOUND ICD-10 ESPECTRA NEGRA MARIE DJ: UDO WIESSMANN HELLS Doors / Start: 19:00 Both e-tickets and limited physical hard tickets are available through HANDS Bandcamp. For those who prefer to begin the year with considerably more noise than champagne, Berlin already has its first serious industrial appointment of 2027. About HANDS Udo Wiessmann founded HANDS in 1990 in his home town of Fürth in Franconia as an outlet for his own projects Atrum, Severance and Winterkälte, starting with limited-edition cassettes and industrial compilations. The first CDs followed in 1994 and the first vinyl, a Winterkälte 7″, in 1995. In the late 1990s the label moved to Dortmund and began issuing full albums on CD, opening with the debuts of Orphx, Ah Cama-Sotz and Needle Sharing and continuing with Mono No Aware, S.I.N.A. and Xabec. Winterkälte’s drum’n’noise records became reference points for the rhythm’n’noise scene, and the catalogue later extended into industrial techno, IDM, drum & bass, breakcore, ambient, electronica and sound art with acts including Nullvektor, Empusae, Geistform, Wieloryb, Monolith, Greyhound and Ontal, alongside reissues of The Klinik back catalogue. Between 1997 and around 2004 the label also ran the vinyl-only power electronics and noise sublabel 220N, and most of its sleeves and paper CD packs are designed by Nicola Bork. Live events sit at the centre of the label’s calendar. Wiessmann started the Forms of Hands label festival in 2001 with Michael Pfefferkorn and the promoter LaborNeun; since 2012 it has taken place at the Förderturm in Bönen in the Ruhr area, and each edition comes with a “Forms Of Hands” compilation of exclusive tracks by the acts on the bill. The Beats and Noise event at the Kulttempel in Oberhausen returns on 10 October 2026 with Sonar, Ancient Methods, Maschinenkrieger KR52, Hysteresis, ICD-10 and Mortaja. In Berlin, a HANDS Label Night at Bi Nuu marked the label’s 28th year in January 2018 before the series settled at Urban Spree, where it now runs twice a year: a summer edition (8 July 2023, 28 June 2025 and 27 June 2026) and a New Year edition. The sold-out 4 January 2025 night had Sonar, Eric De Vries, Greyhound, Templer, Espectra Negra and Phasenmensch on the bill, and 3 January 2026 brought Ah Cama-Sotz, Maschinenkrieger KR52, Supersimmetria, 16Pad Noise Terrorist and Incendie. The 2 January 2027 night is the third New Year edition of HANDS Label Night at Urban Spree in a row.
items._cn_summary: 本文并非乐评，而是关于HANDS厂牌2027年新年柏林专场活动的新闻稿。文章介绍了将在Urban Spree演出的六组艺人SONAR、NULLVEKTOR、GREYHOUND、ICD-10、ESPECTRA NEGRA及MARIE的概况，附带DJ阵容和购票信息，并简述了HANDS厂牌自1990年由Udo Wiessmann创立以来的发展历程，涵盖节奏噪音、工业 techno、IDM、碎核、环境等多种电子音乐分支。文中提及的艺人风格集中在暗潮与工业电子领域，与该用户偏好的实验、前卫及即兴方向有一定交集，但整体内容以演出信息和厂牌历史为主，缺乏对音乐本身的声音设计、艺术手法或创新性的实质性评析，信息价值有限。

items.body: North London post-punk quartet Desperate Journalist have released “Terrible Years“, the first single from their sixth studio album “Gilding the Lily“. The album arrives on November 20, 2026 through Fierce Panda Records on CD and on two vinyl editions, and the band have confirmed UK dates running from November into January 2027. The single appeared on August 24, 2026 with a performance video filmed and edited by Jez Leather. It was one of the last songs written for the record. Singer Jo Bevan explains how the track came together and who is speaking in it: “This is one of the last songs we wrote for the album. Rob had a kernel of an idea for the verse chord progression and we all goaded him into basically writing all the rest of the music one day at rehearsal. Lyrically it’s from the perspective of a character who’s cashed in and moved to LA or somewhere exotic, and is mistakenly under the impression that they are now blissfully balanced (and definitely not in denial about how much they miss the chaos and excitement of their youth). It’s sort of sympathetic but also caustic, as they’re lording it over the people they used to know whilst still clearly being a bit of a mess and scared of how old they’ve become. A lot of this album is about the horror of becoming aware of your own mortality – but, you know, in a fun way.” What is on ‘Gilding the Lily’ “Gilding the Lily” runs to twelve tracks: “Empire”, “Melancholia”, “Terrible Years”, “Landfill”, “Wings”, “20th Century Women”, “Serious, Unimportant”, “Passage”, “Ink”, “Dust”, “Always” and “White Enamel”. The vinyl is housed in a gatefold sleeve. A white vinyl pressing and a CD are available, alongside a limited transparent gold vinyl edition sold direct by the band with a signed postcard while stocks last. “Terrible Years” is also on streaming platforms. The record follows “No Hero”, issued by Fierce Panda on September 27, 2024. Every Desperate Journalist album since the 2015 debut has come out on the same label. Desperate Journalist tour dates November 7, 2026 – Brighton, UK – The Hope & Ruin December 10, 2026 – Birmingham, UK – Hare & Hounds December 11, 2026 – Manchester, UK – The Locker at New Century December 12, 2026 – Nottingham, UK – Bodega December 13, 2026 – Bristol, UK – Exchange December 16, 2026 – London, UK – The Garage January 15, 2027 – Cambridge, UK – Portland Arms January 16, 2027 – Leeds, UK – Lending Room About Desperate Journalist Desperate Journalist formed in North London in 2012 around Jo Bevan on vocals, Rob Hardy on guitar, Simon Drowner on bass and Caroline Helbert on drums. The name comes from “Desperate Journalist in Ongoing Meaningful Review Situation”, a b-side by The Cure. The band issued the “Cristina” EP in 2013 and signed to Fierce Panda Records, which has released everything they have put out since. Their self-titled debut album arrived in 2015, followed by “Grow Up” on March 24, 2017 and “In Search of the Miraculous” on February 22, 2019. A further EP, “You Get Used To It”, appeared in 2018, and guitarist Charley Stone joined the live line-up in November 2018. “Maximum Sorrow!” came out on July 2, 2021, and the concert recording “Live at JT Soar” followed in 2022. Their fifth album, “No Hero”, was released on September 27, 2024. “Gilding the Lily” is the group’s sixth studio album in eleven years and their first new full-length since 2024.
items._cn_summary: Desperate Journalist 是一支来自北伦敦的后朋克四人乐队，他们即将发行第六张录音室专辑《Gilding the Lily》，由 Fierce Panda 唱片公司发行。先行单曲《Terrible Years》于2026年8月释出，主唱 Jo Bevan 透露这首歌从一位搬到洛杉矶或异乡的角色视角出发，表面光鲜实则恐惧衰老，歌词兼具同情与刻毒。主打曲目包括十二首歌曲，涵盖《Empire》《Melancholia》等。专辑延续乐队一贯主题，探讨对自身死亡的认知。乐队将于2026年11月起在英国多地巡演。该文章属于新闻稿性质的信息发布，缺乏对音乐本身的声音分析或艺术评价。

items.body: Six days before their first East Coast run, Portland post-punk quartet Nyx Division released the single “By Design” on 28 August 2026 through Bandcamp. The band play four dates between 3 and 6 September, including A Murder Of Crows XI at New York’s Bowery Ballroom. Sasha Stroud recorded, mixed and mastered the track in August 2026 at Red Lantern Studios in Portland, Oregon. Domino Monet wrote the lyrics and sings; Justin Cory plays guitar, Alex Rivas bass, and Mason Wilkinson drums and percussion. Meg Adamson supplied the cover artwork and layout. The lyric comes out of Monet’s own departure from the Mormon church. She describes the subject of the song as “the liminal expanse between awe and terror”, the point at which the loss of an inherited worldview meets the work of assembling another one. The repeated title turns a phrase normally used to argue for a divinely ordered universe into a statement of self-authorship. The arrangement opens on acoustic guitar and a dry percussive rattle before the full band enters, with Cory’s guitar figures and Wilkinson’s percussion pushing against Rivas’s bassline. Monet holds her notes through the choruses. By Design by Nyx Division Nyx Division tour dates September 2026 The band share the Philadelphia, Worcester and Cambridge dates with eX-Tradition. The New York show is the first of the two main nights of A Murder Of Crows XI, alongside Anja Huwe, Rosegarden Funeral Party, Creux Lies and Guilty Strangers. 3 September 2026 – Philadelphia, PA, USA – Cousin Danny’s Lounge, with eX-Tradition, NRG and Subtle Body 4 September 2026 – New York, NY, USA – Bowery Ballroom, A Murder Of Crows XI 5 September 2026 – Worcester, MA, USA – Distant Castle, with eX-Tradition 6 September 2026 – Cambridge, MA, USA – Middle East Upstairs, with eX-Tradition About Nyx Division Nyx Division formed in Portland, Oregon in 2021 as a four-piece playing post-punk with goth and rock elements. The line-up has held steady since the start: Domino Monet on vocals and lyrics, Justin Cory on guitar, Alex Rivas on bass, and Mason Wilkinson on drums and percussion. The band’s first release, the single “Reckless Dark”, appeared on 5 November 2021, followed by “Orchid Rain” on 4 February 2022. Both were recorded and mixed by Evan Mersky at Red Lantern Studios in Portland and mastered by Parrillat at Niño Rata Studio in Mexico City, as was the “Dark Star” EP that arrived on 4 March 2022. A three-year gap followed. The band returned with the single “Soldier of Love” on 1 August 2025 and the “Midnight Lights” release on 12 September 2025, on which Rivas and Cory added synthesizers to their bass and guitar parts and Wilkinson moved between drums and pad. All of the band’s releases so far have been issued independently, with no label involved. “By Design” is the group’s first new recording since September 2025 and their first with Sasha Stroud at the desk. No album or EP has been announced to follow it.
items._cn_summary: Nyx Division 是一支来自美国波特兰的后朋克四人乐队，2026年8月底发行单曲《By Design》，作为东海岸四场演出的预热。歌曲由主唱 Domino Monet 创作歌词，主题围绕其脱离摩门教后的精神真空——'敬畏与恐惧之间的阈限地带'，标题本身将惯常用于论证神意秩序的短语转化为自我书写的宣言。编曲以原声吉他与干燥打击声开场，随后乐队全员进入，吉他与鼓的棱角对低音线施加张力。作品延续了乐队自2021年以来的稳定阵容与独立发行路线，曾在 EP 与单曲中加入合成器元素，介于后朋克与哥特摇滚之间。整体制作扎实但未呈现明显的实验性突破，偏向传统暗潮框架内的类型化写作。

items.excerpt: 作曲家・三宅純のこれまでの広告音楽（CM音楽）に焦点を当て、三宅氏本人から制作背景やエピソードなどが語られるトークイベント「三宅純の広告音楽 CM TRACKS vol.2」が開催される。日程は2026年10月13日（火）。会場は「晴れたら空に豆まいて」（東京都渋谷区）。出演は三宅純、寺門孝之（選曲、トーク）、原田潤一（選曲、進行）。 CM音楽を広告というコンテクストから切り離し、純粋な音楽作品として掘り下げる本企画。前回（昨年12月）のイベントが大変好評を博したことを受け、今回第2弾の開催となる。 三宅氏の膨大なCM音楽のアーカイブから、寺門、原田の両名が選曲。どの曲が選ばれているのか、三宅氏には事前に一切伝えられていない。そのため、曲が流れた瞬間の反応も含めて、即興的なトークが繰り広げられる、非常にスリリングな一夜となる。   後半には、10月9日（金）に配信リリースされる、三宅氏がスコアを担当したウクライナ映画『Oxygen Station』のサントラを試聴。日本では未公開のため依然謎に包まれている同作の、音楽制作にまつわるエピソードも聞ける貴重な機会となる。 加えて秘
items.body: 作曲家・三宅純のこれまでの広告音楽（CM音楽）に焦点を当て、三宅氏本人から制作背景やエピソードなどが語られるトークイベント「三宅純の広告音楽 CM TRACKS vol.2」が開催される。日程は2026年10月13日（火）。会場は「晴れたら空に豆まいて」（東京都渋谷区）。出演は三宅純、寺門孝之（選曲、トーク）、原田潤一（選曲、進行）。 CM音楽を広告というコンテクストから切り離し、純粋な音楽作品として掘り下げる本企画。前回（昨年12月）のイベントが大変好評を博したことを受け、今回第2弾の開催となる。 三宅氏の膨大なCM音楽のアーカイブから、寺門、原田の両名が選曲。どの曲が選ばれているのか、三宅氏には事前に一切伝えられていない。そのため、曲が流れた瞬間の反応も含めて、即興的なトークが繰り広げられる、非常にスリリングな一夜となる。   後半には、10月9日（金）に配信リリースされる、三宅氏がスコアを担当したウクライナ映画『Oxygen Station』のサントラを試聴。日本では未公開のため依然謎に包まれている同作の、音楽制作にまつわるエピソードも聞ける貴重な機会となる。 加えて秘蔵映像の上映や、NY生活の近況など、この機会でしか聞けない話も期待される。 Listening & Talk Session「三宅純の広告音楽 CM TRACKS vol.2」（ARBAN × 朝河電気 共同企画） 日時：2026年10月13日（火）開場18:30 ／ 開演19:15 会場：晴れたら空に豆まいて（東京都渋谷区代官山町20-20 モンシェリー代官山B2） 料金：前売3,000円 / 当日3,500円 + ドリンク代700円 出演：三宅純／寺門孝之（選曲、トーク）／原田潤一（選曲、進行） 三宅純 ジャズをルーツに、異種交配の限りを尽くし、時代に欠落した音楽を作ることを目指して映画、CM、ダンス、舞台、ドキュメンタリーなど様々なジャンルの作品に楽曲を提供してきた稀代の作曲家。ピナ・バウシュ、ヴィム・ヴェンダース、フィリップ・ドゥクフレ、オリバー･ストーンなど、世界の名だたるアーティストから賞賛を受け、主要な楽曲を提供した『ピナ／踊り続けるいのち』(ヴィム･ヴェンダース監督)ではアカデミー賞にノミネート、ヨーロッパ映画賞でベスト･ドキュメンタリー賞を受賞、オリジナル･アルバム中『Stolen from strangers』『Lost Memory Theatre act-1』『Lost Memory Theatre act-2』『Whispered Garden』４作がドイツ音楽批評家大賞を受賞するなど、パリとニューヨークを拠点に世界的に活躍、2016年8月のリオ・オリンピック閉会式「東京プレゼンテーション」における、「君が代」の前代未聞のアレンジは日本中を驚嘆させた。近年手がけたサウンドトラックには、『9人の翻訳家 囚われたベストセラー』、『嘘はフィクサーのはじまり』、『Oxygen Station』『浮世の画家』、『人間失格：太宰治と3人の女たち』、『雪国-Snow Country-』、そして舞台音楽には『No.9―不滅の旋律―』、『ジャンヌ・ダルク』『サンソン－ルイ16世の首を刎ねた男』『シッダールタ』などがある。 寺門孝之 画家・神戸芸術工科大学教授。大阪大学文学部美学科卒業後、セツ・モードセミナーにて絵を学ぶ。並行して、ニューメディア画像制作会社 ㈱シフカに入社。各種デジタルコンテンツの企画・制作にチーフイラストレーター、ディレクターとして携わった後、1986年退社以降フリーランス。1985年、第６回日本グラフィック展大賞受賞。 神戸・東京を二拠点に光溢れる天使画、闇滴る夢・物語の世界を描き、展覧会での作品発表はじめ、絵本、広告、書籍装画、ライブペインティングなど幅広く活動。三宅純作品のアルバムジャケットのアートワーク、『原宿文楽』（ラフォーレミュージアム）宣伝美術、結城座公演の人形美術・江戸写し絵制作、角川映画『人間失格』（監督/荒戸源次郎）の劇中画など他分野とのコラボレーションも多数。 2023年、新約聖書の受胎告知場面から発想した自作の新作能『或能川』を、神戸・湊川神社神能殿にて人間国宝・大槻文藏氏監修のもと、上野雄三氏を筆頭に総勢３０名の能楽師とともに上演。その中で三宅純楽曲の青葉市子氏によるギター演奏と歌唱、三宅純氏自身のフリューゲルホルン即興演奏と能囃子方とのコラボレーションも実現し、好評を博す。 原田潤一 Montreux Jazz Festival Japan／ARBAN／VISUALNOTES. CEO スイスを本拠地とする世界３大ジャズ・フェスティバル「Montreux Jazz Festival」の日本版「モントルー・ジャズ・フェスティバル・ジャパン」を開催。同フェスではスイスMJFのINTERNATIONAL ADVISORY BOARDメンバーにも名を連ね、日本と欧州の音楽文化を繋ぐ。また、JAZZを中心とする音楽カルチャーメディア「ARBAN」を運営し、大人が楽しめる質の高い音楽情報を日々発信している。 世界を舞台に活躍する作曲家、 三宅純のジャパン・エージェントとしての顔も持ち、NHKドラマの音楽制作などに携わっている。 投稿 三宅純が手がけた「広告音楽」に焦点─リスニング＆トークセッション「三宅純の広告音楽 CM TRACKS vol.2」開催 は ARBAN に最初に表示されました。
items._genre: experimental jazz / film score / world fusion / contemporary classical
items._cn_summary: 本文为日本作曲家三宅純广告音乐聆赏暨对谈活动的预告新闻稿。内容涵盖活动信息、参与嘉宾及三宅純的简历介绍。三宅純以爵士为根基，跨界电影、广告、舞蹈、舞台及纪录片配乐，曾与皮娜·鲍什、文德斯、杜可夫等国际艺术家合作，其作品《皮娜》获奥斯卡提名及欧洲电影奖。其创作风格横跨实验爵士、电影配乐与世界音乐融合，2016年里约奥运闭幕式东京环节对《君が代》的大胆改编曾引起关注。文章本质为活动宣传稿而非乐评，缺乏对具体音乐作品的深度分析与评论价值。

items._cn_summary: 芝加哥新晋艺术家スパークルマミ的首张专辑，以拉丁氛围为基底，融合七十年代放克质感与巴西音乐元素。专辑横跨爵士、放克、灵魂乐与R&B等多种风格，先行单曲展现了跨类型律动的成熟度。创作者受父母影响的墨西哥波莱罗等传统音乐启发，将地域音乐根源与现代都市音乐语汇结合。作为技巧派新人，专辑在类型融合上展现了一定的广度，但整体偏向主流爵士与灵魂乐框架内的精致制作，实验性与前卫性有限。乐评原文较短，更接近新闻稿式的推介，信息量不足以深入评估其艺术深度。

items.body:
Shashwat Bulusu Unpacks Abuse, Self-Harm And Compulsive Lying On 'Pinocchio'

2 September 2026

On his latest album 'Pinocchio', Shashwat Bulusu isn't trying to create a sonic world, as he did with the mix of Hindi-Urdu songwriting and intimate and uniquely lo-fi textures on 2024's 'Fitrat', nor is it a work of catchy choruses and easy rhymes. Instead, the 12-track lyrically dense record focuses heavily on expressing everything that's running inside the Vadodara singer-songwriter's mind. Subsequently, it's also his most personal work to date.

"Pinocchio explores over a decade of my songwriting. You can hear me coming to terms with sexual abuse, self-harm and narcissism in real time," confesses Bulusu. The singer-songwriter notes how abuse growing up, self-harm later in life and compulsive lying as a way to stay safe led him to feel drawn to the story of Pinocchio, a puppet brought to life whose nose grows each time he lies. Bulusu explores this draw over song structures that feel nearly free-flowing over guitar-led arrangements, which range from teeming with energy, like on 'Illusions', to receding to bare-bone strums, like on 'Tiny Man'.

The latter is also a good example of how Bulusu prioritises depth over accessibility on the album, as his themes come shrouded in metaphors that invite interpretation, with lines like: "I could just bend the time // Like the hero I am // I’d kill the tiny man // Or smile or cry or the homunculi". Even more direct passages like "Tonight I say goodbye // To the town that saved me from myself // And I was hoping for more // From the people who gave me all they could have" on the closer 'Daffodils/ Narcissus' come with specifics that aren't for everybody but will land deeply with anyone who connects.

That is the defining feature of the album. Though it does contain instances, like 'Lately', which carries more universal melodic expressions, 'Pinocchio' ultimately is more like a personal diary or personal poetry by one of India's most seasoned singer-songwriters. Unlike with the unique ready appeal of 'Fitrat', it requires a specific amount of active attention and specific experience to connect with you, but if it does, it will do so deeply.

Check out the album below and head to Shashwat Bulusu's artist profile for more information. You can also check out a confession board created to accompany the album release.

items._cn_summary: 这是印度瓦多达拉创作歌手 Shashwat Bulusu 的第三张全长专辑《Pinocchio》，共12首曲目，以吉他为主导编制，风格偏向lo-fi独立民谣，与前作《Fitrat》混合印地语-乌尔都语歌词的方向不同，这次彻底转向内省。专辑围绕作者十余年间对性侵、自我伤害与自恋等创伤的反思展开，并以童话故事中鼻子随说谎变长的木偶匹诺曹为核心隐喻。歌词密度极高，叙事方式接近个人日记或私人诗作，频繁使用隐喻与象征来包裹主题，部分段落趋于晦涩，需要特定的人生经验才能产生共鸣，仅有《Lately》等少数曲目具备较易接近的旋律表达。整体而言，这是一张高度私密、向内挖掘的创作生涯回顾，与实验、前卫或跨界融合的音乐审美关联较弱。

items.body: It will be released through Ideologic Organ next month Kali Malone has shared details of a new album, titled Burning Song. Marking her first LP of solo compositions since 2024's All Life Long, the new LP takes in seven tracks. It was recorded at the historic Thomaskirche in Leipzig, Germany, where Malone became the first musician to perform contemporary works on the church’s Bach organ. Lucy Railton provides cello accompaniment on Burning Song, while Stephen O'Malley also plays bowed acoustic guitar across the album. Recording took place over the course of two late nights in August 2025, with the engineer Francesco Donadello placing over 20 microphones around the room. items._cn_summary: 这篇内容仅为专辑发布的简短新闻稿，介绍了Kali Malone新专辑《Burning Song》的基本制作信息。专辑录制于莱比锡历史悠久的汤玛斯教堂，Malone成为首位在该教堂巴赫管风琴上演奏当代作品的音乐家。专辑包含七首独奏作品，由Lucy Railton担任大提琴伴奏，Stephen O'Malley演奏弓弦木吉他，录音由Francesco Donadello在2025年8月的两个深夜完成，教堂内布置了超过20个麦克风。原文字符数不足，且为纯新闻转载而非原创乐评，信息量有限，无法深入评估音乐本身的表现与创新性。

items._cn_summary: 所给正文主要是乐评开篇及季末环境描写，并提及一组双盒式磁带作品涵盖流水声响、带有历史联想的电子节拍、推想性质的康沃尔民间音乐，以及为医院行程缓和情绪的音乐。现有摘录不足二百字，未呈现具体曲目的编配、演奏方式与实际听感，因而无法判断作品的创新程度、跨领域融合及地域文化特色。整体选题靠近实验电子与世界音乐范畴，但可供评分的信息十分有限。

items.body: King Kong has been deejaying since 1982, when he stepped up to the mic at Tuff Gong studios in Kingston under the name Junior Kong, borrowed from his father, and that same grain in his voice, the one that later carried Firehouse label sides for King Tubby and hits like “Trouble Again” for producer Prince Jammy, is exactly what drives “Send Dem Come.” Josh Harris, also known as DJ Big Feet, produced the track for his own roots label, Big Feet Records, building a heavy, classic reggae foundation underneath King Kong’s vocal, spacious and unhurried. Torch, the Trench Town-raised singer born Kevin Campbell and handed his stage name by Tony Rebel, layers harmony vocals in behind the lead, thickening the track’s Jamaican character. Harris started out as the keyboardist and vocalist in The Untouchables, the Los Angeles ska revival band whose 1985 debut Wild Child reached the UK charts on Stiff Records, before he turned to production and spent years building Big Feet Records into a real bridge between California and Jamaica, releasing music with Ken Boothe, Lutan Fyah, Johnny Osbourne and The Silvertones along the way. Torch built his own name over a decade of Jamaican sessions in the same period, running his own label, Evaburninflame Recordings International, and touring behind Buju Banton since 2005. A separate dub mix comes from E.N Young, the San Diego-based producer and melodica player who runs Imperial Sound Recording Studio and has cut more than 1,250 reggae tracks for artists including Steel Pulse, Stick Figure and Alborosie. Working from the same session, he pulls “Send Dem Come” apart into something deeper and more spacious, in the tradition of the King Tubby and Scientist records he’s named as his own biggest influence. Stream “Send Dem Come” HERE   The post Daily Discovery: Josh Harris aka DJ Big Feet x King Kong x Torch – Send Dem Come appeared first on Rhythm Passport.
items._cn_summary: 这是一篇关于单曲《Send Dem Come》的发行介绍。King Kong 自1982年起在Kingston的Tuff Gong录音室开始说唱生涯，声音承袭King Tubby厂牌经典风格；Josh Harris（DJ Big Feet）在自己的Big Feet Records厂牌下制作了厚重的经典雷鬼基底，Torch 负责和声铺垫，三者共同构建浓厚的牙买加音乐气质。E.N Young另提供dub混音版本，将音轨拆解得更深更空旷，延续King Tubby与Scientist的传统。整篇文章侧重人物背景与厂牌历史介绍，属于新闻稿性质的唱片推介，缺乏对声音设计、实验性或融合层面的深入分析。

items.body: Laufeyiar Sonr released “Tarnished” on 10 August 2026, a two-track single running five minutes and 36 seconds. It is the project’s first new material since the 2006 debut album “Vorst”, which Neuropa Records issued twenty years earlier. The title track runs 3:16 and is backed by “End of Rotation (Finitude)” at 2:20. The single is on Spotify and the usual streaming services. No label is credited on the release, and the project has no Bandcamp page. Several tracks from “Vorst” have also been added to streaming platforms under the Laufeyiar Sonr name, among them “Grey”, “White Girl”, “Through the Burren” and the two-part “Sì An Bhrù”. Those are the 2006 recordings rather than new versions; only “Tarnished” and “End of Rotation (Finitude)” carry a 2026 date. About Laufeyiar Sonr Laufeyiar Sonr is an electronic project whose only album to date is “Vorst”, released on CD in 2006 by the Belgian label Neuropa Records under the catalogue number NRP11, packaged in a 7-inch sleeve. The eleven tracks were “Grey”, “Through The Burren”, “White Girl”, “Grimhild”, “Red Bar”, “Three-Coloured Fields”, “Second Fire”, “Sì An Bhrù I”, “Sì An Bhrù II”, “The Trickster Strikes” and “Grey Park”, and Discogs lists the record under electronic, industrial, experimental and ambient. Discogs credits the project to a single member, working under the name Bastiaen Van Der Karbargenbok. Neuropa Records operated from Haaltert in Belgium and released synthwave, dark ambient and industrial records. The project’s own website is no longer online, and its only other appearance in recent years was “Through the Burren” on the compilation “Dutch Electronic Masters III” in September 2022. “Tarnished” breaks a twenty-year gap in new material.
items._cn_summary: Laufeyiar Sonr 是由 Bastiaen Van Der Karbargenbok 独自操作的电子项目，时隔二十年发布双轨单曲《Tarnished》，包含标题曲三分钟十六秒及配曲《End of Rotation (Finitude)》两分二十秒。此前唯一专辑《Vorst》于2006年由比利时 Haaltert 的小厂牌 Neuropa Records 以 CD 形式限量发行，现已有部分曲目重新上架流媒体平台。Discogs 将其风格归类为电子、工业、实验与氛围，作品横跨暗黑氛围与合成器路线。项目沉寂多年，仅2022年一首曲目出现在合辑中，此次新作打破了二十年的创作空窗期。但原文仅为信息性新闻稿，未对音乐本身做任何分析或评论，缺乏对声音设计、编曲手法及艺术取向的实质讨论。

items.body: Sixteen months after a digital-only first single, Pissoir des Dieux put out their debut album on vinyl. The French project, which brings together Larissa Iceglass of Lebanon Hanover, Vincenzo Wieczerzynski of Chaos International and Owen Pratt of Uncanny Valley, releases the self-titled LP through Fabrika Records on 30 September 2026 in two editions of 500 copies each, one on black vinyl and one on pink. Audioglobe handles export distribution. The trio bring an eighties wave sound with sixties pop and dark folk in it, driven by a mechanical beat. The label files it under cold wave, neo folk and post-punk. What is on the Pissoir des Dieux debut The album runs eight tracks across two sides. Side A is “Casinno Piss”, “I should be Shot”, “Hotel Grand Amour” and “24/7”. Side B is “Vultures”, “Jack Nicholson”, “Internet Cafe” and “Triple Size Coctails”. Hotel Grand Amour by Pissoir des Dieux “Hotel Grand Amour” came out on 8 May 2025 as the project’s first release, digital only, on Fabrika Records, and remains the only track from the album available so far. Its official video is the one visual the project has released to date. The LP has not appeared on the band’s Bandcamp page or in the Fabrika Records web shop yet. Orders currently run through the label’s distribution rather than a direct release page. Fabrika Records reprints She Past Away and Lebanon Hanover Alongside the new album, Fabrika has repressed two of its longest-selling records on regular black vinyl. She Past Away‘s “Belirdi Gece” returns in the embossed and lacquered sleeve used for the tenth-anniversary edition of 2020. The Turkish band first issued the album on their own REMOOV label as a CD-R in 2012; Fabrika’s first vinyl pressing followed on 28 February 2013 in a different sleeve, and the record has since gone through six vinyl editions, four CD editions and a cassette. Lebanon Hanover’s debut album “The World is Getting Colder”, originally released in February 2012 and remastered since, is also back in stock on black vinyl with a download code and a poster. The duo wrote and recorded it in the north-east of England after moving back from Berlin in 2011, and the second album followed shortly afterwards. About Pissoir des Dieux Pissoir des Dieux is a three-way collaboration based in France, formed by Larissa Iceglass, Vincenzo Wieczerzynski and Owen Pratt. Iceglass founded Lebanon Hanover in Sunderland in 2010 with William Maybelline and sings and plays guitar and synthesiser in the duo, which has released through Fabrika Records for most of its catalogue; their most recent album, “Asylum Lullabies”, came out on 10 July 2025. Side-Line covered the “Torture Rack” video that preceded it. Wieczerzynski is a multi-instrumentalist based in Poznań who released a self-titled debut as Chaos International in March 2024 and has worked on Lebanon Hanover sessions. Pratt records as Uncanny Valley, whose debut album “Ugashia” appeared in 2019. Fabrika Records has run from the Athens area of Greece since 2011 and is operated by Dimitris Pavlidis and Joanna of Selofan. Its catalogue includes Selofan, Qual, The Glass Beads, Harsh Symmetry, Second Still, Double Echo and Jennifer Touch alongside She Past Away and Lebanon Hanover. The Pissoir des Dieux LP is the label’s first full-length from the project.
items._cn_summary: 这篇文章并非传统意义上的乐评，而是一篇关于Pissoir des Dieux首张专辑发行的资讯报道。文章主要介绍了这张由Fabrika Records发行的黑胶唱片，包括发行日期、两个限量版本（各500张，黑胶与粉胶）、曲目列表以及分销渠道。音乐风格被描述为融合了八十年代新浪潮、六十年代流行与暗黑民谣的冰冷波浪，辅以机械化节拍驱动。作为一支跨国合作项目，其成员来自Lebanon Hanover、Chaos International和Uncanny Valley等暗潮场景中的知名乐队。文章还附带了厂牌同时再版She Past Away和Lebanon Hanover经典专辑的商业信息。整体内容以事实陈述为主，缺乏对音乐本身的深度分析、审美评价或创作背景的探讨，信息密度较低且偏向行业新闻通稿性质。

items.body: Los Angeles producer Dragan Capor, who works as DC for his studio defrostMusic, released an unofficial remix of Nine Inch Nails‘ “Capital G” on 31 August 2026, accompanied by a video. He made the remix in 2007 from the multitrack files that Nine Inch Nails published during the “Year Zero” campaign, then left it in his archive for nineteen years before rediscovering the session files. The release is non-commercial. Capor states that it is a standalone reinterpretation and that all rights in the original work remain with their owners. It is not connected to Nine Inch Nails, Interscope or any official remix programme. Dragan Capor remixed and produced the track for defrostMusic. Yossi Shakked mastered it and Matteo Castiglioni made the video. The original “Capital G” was written by Trent Reznor and produced by Reznor and Atticus Ross. Where the ‘Capital G’ stems came from “Capital G” is the sixth track on “Year Zero”, the fifth Nine Inch Nails album, released on 17 April 2007 through Interscope Records. It became the record’s second and final single on 11 June 2007, issued in the United Kingdom as a limited 9-inch with a Dave Sitek mix of “Survivalism” on the B side. On 26 April 2007, the official “Year Zero” website posted the multitrack audio for “Capital G” in GarageBand and Logic Pro formats, with WAV files for anyone using other software. It was one of three “Year Zero” songs opened up that day. The invitation produced “Year Zero Remixed”, released on 20 November 2007, whose CD and DVD-ROM edition carried multitrack files for every track on the album in GarageBand, Ableton Live and 16-bit WAV formats. Capor’s version comes out of that first wave. He has said the song’s subject matter, which turns on power, money and political self-interest, reads differently now than it did in 2007. About Dragan Capor Dragan Capor is a producer, digital editor and remixer based in Los Angeles, where he founded and runs the production studio defrostMusic. His professional credits sit largely in jazz, soul and pop rather than industrial music: he has worked with Al Jarreau, Joe Cocker, George Benson, Norman Brown and Patti Austin, and is credited on Norman Brown’s Grammy-winning album “Just Chillin'”. Discogs lists him with writing, arrangement, technical and production credits across a range of releases. Alongside that work he keeps a running set of unofficial remixes on his own channel, presented under the defrostMusic name. Those include a mashup remix pairing Nine Inch Nails material with Lisa Papineau, an extended edit of Peter Gabriel’s “Shock the Monkey” and a Gracie Abrams remix. The “Capital G” version is the oldest of them by nineteen years, and the first he has released from the 2007 sessions.
items._cn_summary: Dragan Capor 于2026年8月31日发布了一首非商业性质的Nine Inch Nails "Capital G" 混音作品。该混音基于2007年"Year Zero"企划期间官方发布的多轨分轨文件制作，尘封十九年后才被重新发现并释出。混音师长期从事爵士、灵魂乐和流行音乐制作，与工业音乐领域交集有限，作品中保留了原曲关于权力、资本与政治利己的主题，并附带Yossi Shakked的母带处理和Matteo Castiglioni制作的视频。该文章本质上是一篇新闻稿性质的发布通告，并非原创乐评，内容侧重于背景信息的罗列，包括"Year Zero"专辑的发行历史、"Capital G"作为单曲的细节以及官方分轨文件的来源说明，缺乏对混音作品本身的音乐分析或艺术评价。

items.body: Max Meyer has not picked up a stringed instrument on stage in about ten years. The singer of the German industrial metal band Devil-M will do it twice in one weekend: he joins Italian dark electronic act Kirlian Camera as guitarist at the Fuchsbau in Chemnitz on 25 and 26 September 2026. Both nights are sold out, and the band will play a different setlist on each. Danse Macabre Records, Devil-M’s label, announced the guest appearance on 31 August. Meyer described the return to guitar as the part that stands out for him: “Nach so langer Zeit wieder mit einem Saiteninstrument auf der Bühne zu stehen, ist definitiv etwas Besonderes. Gleichzeitig ist es eine spannende Herausforderung, bei zwei Konzerten eine Band wie Kirlian Camera zu unterstützen.” In English: standing on stage with a stringed instrument again after so long is definitely something special, and supporting a band like Kirlian Camera across two concerts is an interesting challenge at the same time. He is known first as a vocalist and frontman of Devil-M, but he has worked as a multi-instrumentalist for years and is credited with drums, synths and arrangement on Devil-M records. The arrangement covers the two Chemnitz nights only. The label states that further shows or projects together are not ruled out. Kirlian Camera tour dates for 2026 and 2027 Kirlian Camera keep a single canonical calendar on their own site and warn against buying tickets for shows that do not appear on it. Seven dates are confirmed: 25 September 2026 – Chemnitz, Germany (Fuchsbau, day 1, doors 20:30, show 21:30, sold out) 26 September 2026 – Chemnitz, Germany (Fuchsbau, day 2, doors 20:30, show 21:30, sold out) 3 October 2026 – Parma, Italy (Santa Maria della Pace Church, Colonne28, “Gala in Nero – Lode”, on stage 20:30, total black dress code) 27 November 2026 – Nuremberg, Germany (Der Cult, headliner) 28 November 2026 – Karlsruhe, Germany (Die Stadtmitte, headliner) 28 February 2027 – Bruges, Belgium (De Donkerste Beurs, festival headliner) 16 May 2027 – Leipzig, Germany (Wave-Gotik-Treffen) Thirteen further entries appear on the same calendar as deliberate placeholders, with no country given. The band reveal those to their mailing list before announcing them publicly. Wave-Gotik-Treffen 2027 runs from 14 to 17 May, so the Leipzig date falls on the Sunday of the festival. About Kirlian Camera Angelo Bergamini founded Kirlian Camera in Parma, Italy, in 1979, and the project became the first Italian act signed to Virgin Records. The line-up changed repeatedly through the 1980s and 1990s across a catalogue that moved between synth-pop, dark electronics, martial and neoclassical material. Elena Alice Fossi joined in 2000 as lead singer and composer, and the Bergamini and Fossi pairing has anchored the band ever since. The group have released through Dependent Records for the last three albums: “Hologram Moon” in 2018, “Cold Pills (Scarlet Gate of Toxic Daybreak)” in 2021 and the double album “Radio Signals For The Dying” on 23 February 2024. That last record runs to sixteen tracks and features Julian Assange. Side-Line covered its announcement in Julian Assange featured on new Kirlian Camera LP ‘Radio Signals For The Dying’ out in 2024 and the singles that preceded it, including “Il Tempo Profondo” and “Götter, geht weg!”. Kirlian Camera are not signed to Danse Macabre Records. The label carries the Chemnitz announcement because its own artist is the guest. About Devil-M Devil-M started in Germany in 2009 and mix industrial metal with gothic metal, with Max Meyer on vocals. Their fourth album, “Titanomachie”, came out on Danse Macabre Records in late 2025 on digital, CD and vinyl, and takes its subject from Greek myth; Side-Line covered it in Devil-M return with Greek myth album ‘Titanomachie’. Meyer has been credited across the band’s records for lyrics, arrangement, percussion and synths alongside his vocals, which is the background to the Chemnitz appearance: the guitar is not a new instrument for him, only one he has kept off stage for a decade.
items._cn_summary: 本文并非传统意义上的乐评，而是一则新闻稿：报道Devil-M主唱Max Meyer以客座吉他手身份加入意大利暗潮电子乐队Kirlian Camera，在Chemnitz的Fuchsbau进行两场已售罄的演出。文章同时梳理了Kirlian Camera 2026至2027年的演出日程，以及乐队的历史背景——1979年成立于帕尔马，曾签约Virgin Records，近年通过Dependent Records发行专辑。内容以巡演信息和乐队履历为主，缺乏对音乐本身的分析、音响美学或创作手法的讨论。Kirlian Camera的音乐涉及暗电子、新古典、军乐化合成器流行等元素，与暗潮/工业口味有一定关联，但本文的报道形式和资讯性质使其在艺术评论深度上极为有限。

Casablanca Nights 2: The Unveiled Chapter by Johan Ageb
items.body: Every track on the new Johan Agebjörn album has a different singer on it. The Swedish producer, best known for Sally Shapiro, releases “Falling” featuring Yota on 4 September 2026 as a digital single through Blanco y Negro Music and his own Johan Agebjörn Music. It is the second single from “Casablanca Nights 2: The Unveiled Chapter”, a twelve-track album due on 30 October 2026 and open for pre-order since 21 August. Casablanca Nights 2: The Unveiled Chapter by Johan Agebjörn Yota is a Stockholm-born vocalist and songwriter, credited on Discogs under the name Jotta Hautanen, who now lives in Paris. She described hearing the demo for the first time on a walk in the park: “I recall listening to the demo of ‘Falling’ that Johan sent to me during a walk in the park and it was instantly playing on every emotional chord within me. The progressive and slightly subtle intensity in it just blew me away. It felt right. It was one of those rare moments when something just seems tailored to find its way through every little cell in your body and mind and connect with you. The tension this track carries is quite massive, especially as it’s delivered (at least partially) in a subtle and soft manner. The fact that it also has the elements that I naturally feel drawn to like the whispery and suggestive vocals and an instrumental that is melodic and deep, confirmed my initial feeling even more which was that this just had to happen.” Johan Agebjörn pairs a different singer with every track Agebjörn produced the whole of “Casablanca Nights 2: The Unveiled Chapter” himself and gave each of the twelve tracks its own guest. “Falling” with Yota opens the record, followed by “Beautiful Stranger” with Little Boots, which came out as the first single on 21 August 2026. The rest of the running order is “Fakesnow” with R Missing, “Substitute For Love” with Ellen Andrea Wang, “My Only One” with Fred Ventura, “Hush Hush Baby” with Nina, “Waiting For Magic” with Dana Jean Phoenix and Mikael Ögren, a 2026 mix of “Have You Ever Been In Love” with Tom Hooker, “Love On Ice” with Ryan Paris and Sally Shapiro, “Filled Me Up” with Bunny X, “Will You Be Home For Christmas” with Dana Jean Phoenix, and “Nightbows” with R. Missing. The album is a sequel to “Casablanca Nights”, which Paper Bag Records released in 2011 and which used the same method of a rotating cast of vocalists. About Johan Agebjörn Johan Agebjörn is a producer and songwriter based in Lund, Sweden, who has made italo disco and synth-pop since the mid-2000s. He started Sally Shapiro in 2006 with the track “I’ll Be By Your Side”, and the project’s debut album “Disco Romance” came out on Diskokaine. Later Sally Shapiro records moved through Paper Bag Records and Permanent Vacation, including “My Guilty Pleasure” in August 2009, before the duo signed to Italians Do It Better for “Sally Shapiro” in 2022 and “Ready to Live a Lie” in May 2025. In September 2023 they released a cover of the Pet Shop Boys’ “Rent”. Outside Sally Shapiro, Agebjörn has released solo albums and produced for other singers. “Casablanca Nights” appeared on Paper Bag Records in 2011. He worked with Samantha Fox on “Hot Boy” in 2018 and with Loney Dear on “The Leftovers”, and remixed Annie’s “Swedish Kiss” in 2014. He and Yota had already worked together before this album, on the 2024 EP “Universe In Flames”. “Casablanca Nights 2: The Unveiled Chapter” is his first album under his own name since that collaboration, and “Falling” is the track the pair placed first on it.
items._cn_summary: 本文为一张瑞典制作人专辑的第二支单曲新闻稿，介绍专辑采用每首歌曲邀请不同歌手的合作模式。歌曲由巴黎生活的瑞典歌手Yota演唱，制作人John Agebjörn独立完成全部十二首曲目的制作，并邀请包括Little Boots、Fred Ventura、Ryan Paris等十二组嘉宾参与。该作品延续了他此前在Sally Shapiro项目中建立的italo disco与合成器流行路线，以渐进式情绪推进和轻柔人声为特征。作为续作延续了2011年原版专辑的客串轮换模式，整体仍属于主流合成器流行范畴，虽有暗潮元素潜流，但实验性有限，缺乏真正意义上的创新突破。

items.body: San Diego synthpop trio Twin Ritual released the single “Suffocate” on 28 August 2026. It is the band’s first new recording since “Allie” in May 2023 and is out on Bandcamp. Hannah Mahute wrote the lyrics and sings. Anthony Ramirez, who also plays in Glass Spells, handles synthesizers, bass and drum machine, and Antonio Estrada plays guitars. The band wrote the song together. Vocals and guitars were recorded at Chateau Trumfio, and Dave Trumfio mixed and mastered the track. Suffocate by Twin Ritual How ‘Suffocate’ sounds The arrangement runs on a steady drum-machine pulse and wide synthesizer lines, with Estrada’s guitar set in open, measured phrases that alternate between texture and lead melody. Mahute sings in the centre of that space, moving between a soft delivery and a sharper one. The song deals with staying beside someone who is withdrawing into their own pain, and with the limits of what patience can do about it. Dave Trumfio’s involvement links the single to a long run of American independent rock records. He founded Kingsize Soundlabs in Chicago’s Wicker Park in the 1990s and moved the studio to Los Angeles in 2000, and has produced or engineered for Wilco, Built to Spill, My Morning Jacket and OK Go. Here he handled the mix and the master. About Twin Ritual Twin Ritual are a three-piece from San Diego, California, built around Hannah Mahute’s vocals, Anthony Ramirez’s synthesizers and rhythm programming, and Antonio Estrada’s guitar. Their music mixes synthpop with atmospheric guitar and a slow-burning, cinematic pace. The band’s first release, the single “Angry”, appeared on 12 October 2017. The “Hand Through The Mist EP” followed on 9 February 2018. “Norma Jean” arrived as a single on 29 October 2019, and “Allie” on 5 May 2023. Ramirez is also a member of Glass Spells, the San Diego synthpop project Side-Line has covered separately. Twin Ritual’s own releases have all been issued independently rather than through a label. “Suffocate” ends a three-year gap in the band’s discography. No album or EP has been announced to follow it.
items._cn_summary: Twin Ritual是一支来自圣地亚哥的合成器流行三人组合，单曲《Suffocate》延续了乐队一贯的合成器流行与氛围吉他融合路线，节奏以鼓机脉冲为骨架，宽阔的合成器音线与安東尼奥·埃斯特拉达的开放式吉他段落交替铺陈。歌词由主唱汉娜·马胡特撰写，主题围绕陪伴一个逐渐封闭自我的人以及耐心的边界展开，嗓音在柔和与锋利之间切换。混音与母带由戴夫·特鲁姆菲奥操刀，他与Wilco、Built to Spill等独立摇滚圈的渊源为这首独立发行的单曲带来了一定制作保障。作为一首独立厂牌发行的合成器流行单曲，作品在编曲与制作上较为规整，但缺乏明显的实验性突破或跨类型融合元素，与偏重实验、前卫和爵士的听众口味存在一定距离。
